definitions.gloss: small blessing; a slightly good fortune (on an omikuji)
definitions.explanation: A fortune level on an {御神籤|おみくじ} indicating a small amount of good luck. It generally ranks below {中吉|ちゅうきち} (middle blessing).

examples.japanese: おみくじは{小吉|しょうきち}だった。
examples.english: The omikuji was a small blessing.

examples.japanese: {小吉|しょうきち}でも、{書|か}いてある{言葉|ことば}は{前向|まえむ}きだった。
examples.english: Even though it was a small blessing, the words written on it were positive.

examples.japanese: {小吉|しょうきち}は{大|おお}きな{幸運|こううん}ではないが、{努力|どりょく}{次第|しだい}で{良|よ}い{方向|ほうこう}に{向|む}かうという{意味|いみ}がある。
examples.english: A small blessing isn't great fortune, but it carries the meaning that things can improve depending on your efforts.

notes:
A modestly good fortune on an おみくじ, ranking below {中吉|ちゅうきち}. The ordering of fortunes varies by shrine, and at some shrines {小吉|しょうきち} ranks above {末吉|すえきち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小吉|しょうきち}を{引|ひ}く: to draw a small blessing
- おみくじで{小吉|しょうきち}が{出|で}る: to get a small blessing on a fortune slip
